description: This is a C source file implementing a driver for the Atmel SAM0 series watchdog timer within the Zephyr RTOS, including initialization, configuration, and interrupt handling.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_wait_synchronization
methods.description: Waits for the watchdog synchronization to complete.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_set_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the watchdog timer.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if the watchdog timer is enabled.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_timeout_to_wdt_period
methods.description: Converts a timeout in milliseconds to a watchdog period register value.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_isr
methods.description: Interrupt Service Routine for the watchdog timer.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_setup
methods.description: Configures and starts the watchdog timer with specified options.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_install_timeout
methods.description: Installs a timeout configuration for the watchdog timer.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_feed
methods.description: Feeds (kicks) the watchdog to prevent reset.

methods.name: wdt_sam0_init
methods.description: Initializes the watchdog driver during system startup.
